title: Joint 3 Harmonic Drive Gearbox Degradation & Thermal Seizure
symptoms: High-frequency acoustic grind between 2.2 kHz and 3.5 kHz
Torque spikes during descent motion (> 300 Nm)
causal_mechanism: Lubrication breakdown leading to gear tooth micro-pitting and thermal expansion friction in the harmonic wave generator.
corrective_actions: Inspect harmonic grease discoloration and metallic particulate count
Replace harmonic drive assembly if backlash exceeds 0.4 arcmin

title: Pneumatic Gripper Pressure Drop & Tire Bead Slip
symptoms: Line pressure dropping below 4.5 bar during clamping cycle
Acoustic hiss signature in 5.0 kHz - 6.5 kHz band
Tire bead seating offset exceeding 1.5 mm
causal_mechanism: Solenoid valve O-ring seal blow-by or quick-disconnect fitting micro-fracture under rapid cycle pressure pulses.
corrective_actions: Perform acoustic bubble leak test on primary supply manifold
Replace valve manifold cartridge and verify supply regulator at 6.2 bar
Recalibrate gripper radial concentricity laser sensor

title: Encoder/Resolver Signal Noise & Kinematic Jitter
symptoms: Angular position jitter (> 0.2 deg fluctuation at rest)
Motor current oscillations without corresponding mechanical load
Normal temperature (< 55°C) and normal acoustic baseline
causal_mechanism: Resolver shield ground loop or loose M12 connector pin inducing EMI noise from adjacent servo drive inverter cables.
corrective_actions: Check shield continuity to protective earth (PE < 0.1 ohm)
Inspect M12 connector pins for fretting corrosion
Reroute resolver cable with 200mm separation from 400V power conduit

title: 3-Phase Line Voltage Sag & Servo Drive Undervoltage Trip
symptoms: Simultaneous current spikes across all active joint axes
Emergency Stop trigger F3002 (DC Bus Undervoltage)
causal_mechanism: Main plant bus voltage sag triggered by heavy auxiliary load switching (e.g. nearby autoclave or compressor start).
corrective_actions: Inspect main power transformer tap settings
Verify uninterruptible power supply (UPS) buffer capacitor bank health
Reset safety relay and verify 400V phase balance within ± 2%

title: Thermocouple Wire Degradation & False Overheat Readout
symptoms: Thermal sensor reporting > 90°C instant step-function jump
Motor current and torque remain completely normal and nominal
Acoustic audio signature shows healthy baseline (< 70 dB)
causal_mechanism: PT100/Type-K thermocouple lead wire pinch in cable track causing intermittent high-resistance short circuit, generating artificial temperature spikes while motor is physically cool.
corrective_actions: Perform physical infrared thermometer spot-check on motor housing
Measure thermocouple resistance at terminal block (nominal ~110 ohms at room temp)
Replace flex cable harness through energy chain track
